af9.space_elevator.console.drone_tooltip: Mining Drone: kept here, never used up

af9.space_elevator.hint.0: Finish the structure: the preview shows both sizes, the size switch picks one.
af9.space_elevator.hint.1: Ready: the next expedition starts by itself.
af9.space_elevator.hint.2: Out to the asteroid and back: its ore goes to the output buses.
af9.space_elevator.hint.3: An expedition takes %s EU/t (%sA %s). The hatches supply %s.

af9.space_elevator.hint.16: Something stands over the cable. It needs open sky above it.

af9.space_elevator.hint.17.motors: Mining Modules %s need Motors %s: these are %s. Upgrade the motors.

af9.space_elevator.hint.19: An expedition takes %s B of hydrogen: fill a fluid input hatch.

af9.space_elevator.error.motors: All Space Elevator Motors must be of the same tier
af9.space_elevator.error.sky: The Space Elevator Cable needs open sky above it
af9.compute.array.stalled: Not computing: no energy, no coolant or no cards
af9.compute.array.unfed: %s processors without RAM run at a quarter
af9.compute.array.no_coolant: No coolant in the Coolant Hatches: nothing computes
af9.compute.array.no_outlet: No Computation Transmitter Hatch: its computation reaches nothing
af9.scanner.hint.15: Not enough air cooling: add Air Conditioning Hatches (the CU must reach the node's heat load).
af9.air_conditioning_hatch.tooltip.0: Cools a Photolithography Line or Scanner with air.
af9.air_conditioning_hatch.tooltip.1: 1 cooling unit at MV, doubling per tier. A print needs 1 (350 nm) to 16 (65 nm) units; two hatches fit.
af9.air_conditioning_hatch.tooltip.2: Draws a quarter of an amp of its tier while a print runs. Every doubling above the heat load: prints 10% faster, 20% fewer broken wafers.
af9.air_conditioning_hatch.tooltip.3: The warm air leaves from the front: keep it clear.
af9.metrology_station.tooltip.0: The fab's measuring tool: it stands next to the lithography machines.
af9.metrology_station.tooltip.1: A run (a Monitor Wafer, 24 CWU/t through a computation hatch) measures the prints of every Line, Scanner and Orbital Station within 32 blocks.
af9.metrology_station.tooltip.2: For ten minutes after a run, and while one is measuring, their prints break 15% less often.
af9.metrology_station.tooltip.3: Needs a Computation Reception Hatch in its structure; one wafer comes back nine times in ten.
af9.metrology.range: Feedback to the lithography machines within %s blocks
af9.metrology.feedback: Feeding back to the machines: %s:%s left
af9.metrology.idle: No feedback: start a run with a Monitor Wafer
af9.wafer_coater.tooltip.0: The spin-coat track in front of the lithography machines: HMDS prime, bottom anti-reflective coat, resist, topcoat, soft bake.
af9.wafer_coater.tooltip.1: A blank wafer goes in, the coated wafer of its node comes out; the Line, Scanner and Orbital Station print only coated wafers.
af9.wafer_coater.tooltip.2: What the spin spins off is spent resist solvent: a fluid output hatch takes it, a Fractionating Still or Rectification Column recovers most of it.
af9.wafer_coater.tooltip.3: A Parallel Hatch coats several wafers at once. Plascrete, 3x3x6; hatches on any plascrete.
af9.litho.multipatterning.on: Multi-patterning on: this machine now prints the mode one version above its own, exposing every layer twice.
af9.litho.multipatterning.busy: Not while a print is running.
af9.jade.multipatterned: Multi-patterned: twice the time, breaks x1.5, twice the OPC
